# International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM)

> > IAVM is the premier professional association for venue management professionals, offering CVP and CVE certifications, industry research through VenueDataSource, and resources for public assembly venue operators worldwide.

IAVM serves venue managers across arenas, stadiums, convention centers, performing arts centers, and amphitheaters. The association provides professional development through certifications (CVP, CVE), specialized training programs (AVSS, GuestX, SES, VMS), networking opportunities, and industry publications including Venue Professional Magazine.

## Key Topics

- CVP (Certified Venue Professional)
- CVE (Certified Venue Executive)
- Venue management best practices
- Public assembly venues
- Professional certification and development
- VenueDataSource research
- GuestX (guest experience)
- AVSS (Academy for Venue Safety & Security)
- SES (Severe Event Scenarios)
- VMS (Venue Management School)
- Leadership Institute
- ADA compliance and accessibility
- Convention center operations
- Venue Professional Magazine
- Industry awards and recognition

## Membership & Professional Development

- [Professional Membership](https://iavm.org/membership/professional-membership): IAVM professional membership with CVE certification and VenueNet access
- [Young Professional Membership](https://iavm.org/membership/young-professional-membership): IAVM membership tier for young professionals with CVP benefits
- [Career Center](https://iavm.org/career-learning/career-center): IAVM job board for venue management careers and employer postings

## Certifications & Training

- [CVP Renewal FAQ](https://iavm.org/career-learning/certifications/certified-venue-professional/cvp_renewal_faq): FAQ for CVP certification renewal and continuing education requirements
- [ADA and the Venue Industry](https://iavm.org/ada-and-the-venue-industry): Guide to ADA compliance and accessibility in venue management
- [A Safer Workplace: Preventing Sexual Harassment](https://iavm.org/a-safer-workplace-preventing-sexual-harassment): Training on workplace safety and sexual harassment prevention for venues

## Publications & Resources

- [Venue Professional Magazine](https://iavm.org/venue-professional-magazine): IAVM's flagship publication on venue management and industry topics
- [Past Issues](https://iavm.org/venue-professional-magazine/past-issues): Archive of past Venue Professional magazine issues via Bluetoad

## Leadership & Governance

- [IAVM Board of Directors](https://iavm.org/about/leadership-and-staff/iavm-board-of-directors): IAVM board members and executive officers from major venue organizations
- [Research Committee](https://iavm.org/about/boards-committees-and-task-forces/research-committee): IAVM Research Committee members managing VenueDataSource initiatives

## Operational Best Practices

- [Pressing the EASY BUTTON! – Making Convention Centers Easier to Work With](https://iavm.org/pressing-the-easy-button-making-convention-centers-easier-to-work-with-audio-only): Audio on improving convention center operations and customer service
- [Programming Outside of the Box](https://iavm.org/programming-outside-of-the-box): Resource on innovative venue programming and event strategies
- [Breaking Down Departmental Walls Through Constructive Collaboration](https://iavm.org/breaking-down-departmental-walls-through-constructive-collaboration): Guide to improving cross-departmental collaboration in venue operations

## Leadership Development

- [Women in Leadership – Audio Only](https://iavm.org/women-in-leadership-audio-only): Audio presentation on women in leadership for venue professionals
- [Leadership Clarity via a Very Different Route](https://iavm.org/leadership-clarity-via-a-very-different-route): Professional development resource on leadership for CVE/CVP professionals
- [Career Success: Position Yourself for Career Success in Hospitality and Tourism](https://iavm.org/career-success-position-yourself-for-career-success-in-hospitality-and-tourism): Career development guide for hospitality and tourism professionals
- [Team Oriented](https://iavm.org/team-oriented): Professional development resource on team building in venue management
- [Keeping an Eye on the Ball](https://iavm.org/keeping-an-eye-on-the-ball): Resource on maintaining focus in venue management operations

- [Privacy Policy](https://iavm.org/about/privacy-policy): IAVM privacy policy covering data collection and GDPR compliance
